about_the_game:
Neuroshima Hex - Sharrash




In the shadows of the ruined cities and deep within forgotten bunkers, something stirred. Born from radiation, desperation, and centuries of isolation, a new threat emerged-not mechanical, not vegetal, but verminous and cunning.
The Sharrash are a faction of mutated rats-intelligent, agile, and ruthless. They strike from underground, vanish into tunnels, and set deadly traps for the unwary. Survivors speak of swift attacks, of foes that were never seen, only heard. Where Sharrash strikes, silence and decay follow.

Key Features:

🐀 New Faction: Sharrash - Command a horde of mutated rats and their ruthless leaders.

🐀 Guerrilla Warfare - Lay traps, sabotage enemies, and exploit superior mobility.

🐀 "Underground" Mechanics - Appear where least expected, then vanish into the shadows.

🐀 Unique Units - Use a mix of fragile but fast attackers and devastating support abilities.

short_description: Command a Sharrash army! A cunning faction of mutated rats from underground bunkers. Use mobility, traps, and guerrilla tactics to outsmart enemies. Sneaky, unpredictable, and deadly in the ruins of the old world.
